text: This administration's environmental record is nothing short of catastrophic. While they boast about planting a few thousand trees, they conveniently ignore that carbon emissions rose for the third straight year and two major waterways were reclassified as ecologically dead. A panel of scientists hand-picked by the governor's office declared the state's air quality 'satisfactory,' but independent researchers tell a very different story. The opposition leader, who has been pushing for stronger environmental protections, was recently mocked by the governor as 'someone who probably cries when a tree gets cut down' — as if caring about the air your children breathe is something to be ashamed of. Our rivers are dying, our forests are burning, and our leaders are laughing. The time for half-measures is over.
